newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt extends deadline for Alamein BOT airport.
newsitem.headline: Egypt extends deadline for Alamein BOT airport.

text.p: Egypt's Civil Aviation Authority said on Wednesday it had postponed until March 31 the date for opening tenders to build an international airport at El Alamein under a BOT (build, operate, transfer) formula.
It is the second postponement of the procedure, previously set for December 31 and then January 30.
The El Alamein airport project, on the Mediterranean coast west of Alexandria, is one of seven Egypt is offering to the private sector under a BOT formula.
The most advanced of them is for an airport at Marsa Alam on the Red Sea coast. The authorities have been negotiating details of that project with a Kuwaiti company.
